Raw 1/2/3/8/9 counts: p1801 802/278/321/29/7, p1802 479/310/584/54/10, p1803 300/212/883/30/12, p1804 1296/92/35/10/4, p1805 92/227/1084/24/10, p1806 1083/271/67/12/4 -- equal to the PREGUNTA 18 marginals to the published decimal on all 30 cells (e.g. Empleados/as públicos 55.8/19.3/22.3/2.0/0.5 of 1437). validate_items.R --table-sets PASS (6 items, resp {1,3}). text_source=study_materials: item_text = the six P.18 grid rows read from the scanned questionnaire page 4 rendered at 220 dpi and read visually (no OCR engine), cross-checked exactly against the ES2938 variable labels. instructions = the P.18 lead-in verbatim, asserted an exact substring of the Es2938pdf.pdf marginals text layer (PREGUNTA 18) and agreeing with the questionnaire image; placed in instructions because it frames every item of this single-grid, single-section table (batch_474/475 CIS single-grid precedent); 'P.18' and column markers not shipped; section_prompt blank. The .do's NO LEER rule recodes 2 to missing, so the live table is binary with resp in {1,3} (gap at 2 is intentional, 1 = positive, 3 = negative, higher = more negative); no option row for 2 is shipped because 2 does not occur in the live data. STEP 3b: dictionary Description 'Opinion of occupational groups including entrepreneurs' matches P.18; live codes are literally the CIS variable names; no instrument mismatch. RIGHTS: no block; applied the existing instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow, every CIS survey year, irw#2381); CIS's own questionnaire. No register row written. Siblings (motives, unemployment in flight in batch_476; earlier spain_2012_* tables) not touched.
